build_catchnet: build a Haiku RNNCore network for the catch environment with policy logits and value outputs
build_atari_shallow_torso: build a shallow convolutional torso network for Atari from the DQN paper using Conv2D layers
build_atari_deep_torso: build a deep residual torso network for Atari from the IMPALA paper with ResidualBlock layers
build_atarinet: build an Atari network with optional ResNet torso and LSTM core for policy and value outputs
build_residual_block: build a residual block module with two Conv2D layers and skip connection for Haiku networks
